text: 【央行将召开股票回购增持再贷款座谈会】据业内人士透露，下周一央行将与金融监管总局、证监会召集各大银行开会，研究优化股票回购增持再贷款政策。业内猜测，此次会议大概率是金融管理部门为进一步稳定市场做准备。
text_en: [PBOC to Hold Symposium on Relending for Stock Buybacks and Increased Shareholdings] Sources in the industry said that next Monday the PBOC, together with the National Financial Regulatory Administration and the CSRC, will convene a meeting with major banks to study optimizing the relending policy for stock buybacks and increased shareholdings. Industry insiders speculate that the meeting is most likely the financial regulators' preparation for further stabilizing the market.
